text:
Aisha: linking the postmortem for the canary incident last night: https://redwood.ai/postmortems/2026-03-19-canary-variant-schema-failure
Aisha: short version: a model variant returned malformed payloads, our canary split concentrated on a single route, caused cascading errors. Need concrete follow-ups and owners.
Tom: agreed. top priority is an auto-rollback tied to schema validation + error spike. Proposal: rollback when schema_fail_rate_by_route > 4% for 90s AND http_error_rate > 2% for 90s.
Riley: also we should enforce per-route canary caps at deploy time. right now deploys specify 10% across the service which can be dominated by one hotspot.
Devon: i can take the per-route cap work. plan: add per-route cap validation in the deploy API + enforcement in the rollout planner. ETA: 2026-03-30.
Sofia: I'll add a telemetry metric: schema_fail_rate_by_route and a dashboard alert. ETA: 2026-03-25.
Tom: i'll own the rollback implementation. rough timeline: feature + unit tests 2 days, integration tests 1 day, infra review 1 day. target merge 2026-03-24.
Riley: i'll update canary docs and add a recommended default: max 5 routes in canary and per-route cap 3% of traffic.
Aisha: please add a regression test that floods one route with malformed responses to validate the rollback and cap behavior.
Devon: adding checklist items to the postmortem follow-ups doc with owners + dates. Will create release-board card and link.
deploy-bot: "deploy-bot: canary deployment 2026-03-19T23:14 triggered: model-v2 -> 10% across service (observed: route /v1/generate received ~68% of canary traffic)"
Riley: +1 on route-limited canaries. also suggest a short-circuit that stops new canaries if median route skew > 40% for 5 minutes.
Tom: draft rollback config for review:
```
rollback_policy:
  scope: per_route
  triggers:
    - id: schema_fail_rate
      metric: schema_fail_rate_by_route
      threshold: 0.04
      duration: 90s
    - id: http_error_rate
      metric: http_error_rate_by_route
      threshold: 0.02
      duration: 90s
  action: auto_rollback
```
Tom: i'll open PR today (WIP #3479) and add unit tests. Riley/Sofia please review.
Sofia: will wire up the metric and a short alert: page if auto_rollback fires twice for same service in 24h.
Aisha: schedule a 15-min sync Friday to check status and unblock. If any roadblocks, escalate to platform oncall.
Devon: noted. i'll post the release-board card link once created.
Sofia: adding a small perf test that simulates canary traffic skew and malformed payloads to CI. ETA 2026-03-26.
Riley: also recommend a runbook addition: when auto_rollback triggers, do quick triage steps: identify affected route, revert variant, check KV cache consistency, follow up with model team. I'll draft the runbook.
Aisha: thanks all — please update the postmortem follow-ups with explicit owner/date lines. cc: platform and oncall as needed. :thumbsup:
